resources.string: Measures how far you scroll and blurs apps until you take a walk.

DoomWalk measures the vertical distance you scroll in other apps (in metres) and blurs them once the scrolling you earned by walking is used up.\n\nIt only receives scroll and app-switch events. It cannot read what is on your screen, and nothing leaves your phone: the app has no internet permission.
